cellular_age.sentence: Cellular age is not reported: on the immune identity gauge the healthy age curve moves 0.47 mA/yr against a within-laboratory spread of 0.0235, so one array resolves age to about 50 years (16 of 100 healthy donors within +/-10 yr; PROC-AGE-01). The healthy aging TRAJECTORY itself is real and reproduced here (0.47 mA/yr, monotone by decade, four laboratories; CPG-VAL-015 found the same slope on Hannum) - it is a population measurement, and one array cannot resolve a person's position on it.
